games.whomost.name: Who's the Most?
games.whomost.tagline: The host asks. Who fits best? The chosen one's phone lights up.
games.whomost.howTo: The host writes "Who's the most..." questions and everyone votes in secret. Then all phones go on the table — and the chosen one's phone lights up gold. At the end: star of the night.
games.impostor.name: The Impostor
games.impostor.tagline: Everyone gets the same word. One doesn't. Find them.
games.impostor.howTo: Everyone gets a secret word — except one, who finds out they're the impostor. On your turn, say a word out loud that's related to the secret word. Argue, vote out loud — and when you've decided, the host reveals.
games.undercover.name: Impostor: Pro Level
games.undercover.tagline: The impostor has a word too. They don't even know they're the impostor.
games.undercover.howTo: Everyone gets a word — but the impostor gets a different one, and doesn't know it. In a clue round everyone says one word out loud; then you argue and vote secretly on your phones. All screens reveal together: both words, who the impostor was, and who got it right.
games.colorrules.name: Color Rules
games.colorrules.tagline: The screen commands. You obey — or you're out.
games.colorrules.howTo: The screen fills with a color + a command: Touch! Shout! Stand up! ⚡ White = don't touch at all. A mistake or a hesitation costs a heart. 3 hearts and you're out — last one standing wins.
games.simon.name: Scattered Simon
games.simon.tagline: The phones light up in turn. Remember — together.
games.simon.howTo: The phones light up in a sequence that keeps getting longer. Remember the order and replay it together — each of you taps your own screen exactly when it's your turn in the sequence. You're one team: 3 lives for everyone.
games.deathtouch.name: Touch of Death
games.deathtouch.tagline: A killer is on the loose. Guard your phone.
games.deathtouch.howTo: One of you has a secret role: the killer 🔪 During the hunting window — phones on the table, hands up — the killer tries to touch a victim's screen without getting caught. Then: accusations and a vote.
games.demons.name: The Little Demons
games.demons.tagline: Score points. Launch a demon at a friend's screen.
games.demons.howTo: Score points by tapping the stars that pop up on your screen. When the meter fills — launch a demon 👹 at a rival's screen: it hides their stars for a few seconds. Most points in a minute wins.
games.alias.name: Tip of the Tongue
games.alias.tagline: Describe it without saying the word.
games.alias.howTo: Your turn: a word appears on your screen — describe it out loud without saying it (and not in another language!). Friends shout guesses. Got it? Tap ✓ for the next one. How many can you get in 45 seconds?
games.trivia.name: Trivia
games.trivia.tagline: Everyone answers. Fastest and right wins.
games.trivia.howTo: A question appears on everyone's phone at the exact same second. Answer on your phone — the faster you answer, the more points you get. 8 questions, sharpest mind wins.
games.bombs.name: Bomb Shower
games.bombs.tagline: We're one team. The bombs are against all of us.
games.bombs.howTo: You're one team against the bombs 💣 A bomb drops on your screen? Swipe it to a friend, or defuse it by type: sticky — rub it, double — hold together. Don't let it blow!
games.wall.name: The Wall
games.wall.tagline: The swarm comes in the dark. Every role holds the line.
games.wall.howTo: Pick a role: 🚁 Helicopter (drag to fly anywhere — drops bombs on its own, dodge the anti-air fire) · 🏹 Archer (touch and hold on a target — fires on its own) · 💣 Gunner (aim and launch a shell) · 🔫 Machine gunner (hold and drag — sprays the whole field). Kill the swarm before it breaks the wall. Every kill = XP and personal upgrades, and every wave brings more pushes at once — you only reach the late waves with lots of players!
games.forehead.name: On the Forehead
games.forehead.tagline: Everyone sees who you are. Except you.
games.forehead.howTo: Put the phone on your forehead — screen facing your friends. Everyone sees who you are, except you. On your turn ask yes/no questions, and when you're sure — guess! Your friends are the judges.
games.show.name: Show
games.show.tagline: Everyone's phones = one giant screen. Lights, waves and scrolling text.
games.show.howTo: Your phone becomes a pixel in a giant screen the whole room builds together ✨ Brightness to max, hold the screen facing out — and the operator runs the lights.
games.pods.name: Pods
games.pods.tagline: A pod lights up — grab it.
games.pods.howTo: Spread the phones on the table — they're light pods. A pod lights up? Run to it and touch it as fast as you can. The system measures your reaction time in milliseconds.
games.thieves.name: The Thieves
games.thieves.tagline: The mountain's run dry. The only gold left is in your friends' dens.
games.thieves.howTo: Everyone is a thieving raccoon with a den of their own. Mine gold from the mountain in the middle and carry it home — a stone deposited in your den ripens and makes gold every second. But the mountain runs dry, and then the only gold left is in your friends' dens: sneak into someone's den, steal a crystal — and the whole room watches you run off with it. Touching a thief makes them drop the loot, and whoever gets there first takes it. Next to every den stands a watchtower that shoots pebbles at intruders — a sharp turn dodges it. Every minute — freeze! Everyone stops for 12 seconds and can buy one upgrade with their gold: for themselves (speed, big sack, dash, cake…) or for their den (stronger tower, fence, safe, honey…). In the last minute everything is worth 3×.
games.hofrim.name: The Diggers
games.hofrim.tagline: Dig down, drop gold sacks on monsters, and build a crazy weapon.
games.hofrim.howTo: Dig tunnels in the direction of your thumb and collect crystals and gold. A gold sack wobbles for a second before it falls — get out of the way, and it crushes any monster beneath it. Go back to the elevator to deposit, and every deposit raises your level and unlocks an upgrade. The deeper you go, the harder the rock and the richer the loot.
games.abyss.name: The Abyss
games.abyss.tagline: Everyone falls down the same shaft. At the ledge — stop or keep going. The pot waits for the last one.
games.abyss.howTo: Everyone drops down the same shaft, each on their own phone — move your thumb to dodge rocks and collect crystals. Every 20 seconds a ledge arrives: everything freezes for 3 seconds and everyone chooses in secret — stop and bank the crystals safely, or keep going and double. Then everyone reveals together. Get caught and your loot goes to the pot. Those who stopped watch their friends live and throw them help or traps. The last one still going who survives one more ledge — takes the whole pot.
games.floors.name: The Floors
games.floors.tagline: Everyone climbs the same tower. Every minute — a freeze, and one upgrade out of six.
games.floors.howTo: Everyone picks a character, and everyone climbs the same tower on their own phone: thumb sideways to run, tap anywhere to jump — and the faster you run, the higher you jump. The wall bounces you back without losing speed. Jumps of 2+ floors in a row = combo, and the combo is worth points squared. The tower rises and whoever falls below the screen loses a life (5). Every minute — a 15-second freeze: everyone picks one upgrade out of six, and sees what everyone took. Hammer, snowball, banana, double jump… The winner — most floors and combos.
games.tanks.name: The Cannons
games.tanks.tagline: Everyone fires in the same second. Whoever's left standing — wins.
games.tanks.howTo: Everyone is a little tank on one mountain, on their own phone. 12 seconds to aim: pull your thumb back like a slingshot — the direction is the angle, the distance is the power, and a dotted line shows where the shell will fly. Watch the wind! Then — salvo: all shells take off together on every phone, the mountain crumbles, and whoever gets hit loses a life. After every salvo the garage opens: 12 seconds to buy upgrades from a bank of 100+ cards — MIRV, napalm, drill, shield, teleport, curses on friends, a flood on everyone… and everyone sees what each one bought. The dead don't wait: every round they drop a meteor or bless a friend from the sky. Two battles, the build carries over. The winner — most kills, survival and wins.
games.metro.name: Metronoball
games.metro.tagline: Every phone is a bouncing ball. One sets the tempo — everyone tunes in by ear.
games.metro.howTo: Every phone is a metronome that looks like a bouncing ball — every landing is the sound. Each round one player sets the tempo (10 seconds with buttons, 50 levels) and picks a floor — parquet, tiles, rubber, water… every floor sounds different. Then 30 seconds: everyone taps the screen at the tempo they hear, and each ball bounces at the tempo of their taps. Nobody sees the number — you only hear the setter's ball and try to land with it. Whoever locks onto the tempo fast and precisely scores the most, and when all the balls land together — everyone in sync! 🎶 Bonus for all. Solo: the tempo changes every 30 seconds — catch it.
games.spods.coach_note: 📱 The host's phone is the coach's remote — it's not a pod.
games.sp_colors.name: Color Race
games.sp_colors.tagline: A sound — everyone runs. Each to their own color only.
games.sp_colors.howTo: Phones in a row 10 meters away. Kids on the start line, each with a color. The "go" sound — all pods light up in shuffled colors, everyone runs, touches only their own color and comes back to the line. Fastest across the rounds wins. 📱 The host's phone is the coach's remote — it's not a pod. Place 4–6 phones in a row (screen up) ~10 m from the start line. Kids in a row on the line.
games.sp_duel.name: Duel
games.sp_duel.tagline: Two kids, four pods, 45 seconds. Then swap pairs.
games.sp_duel.howTo: Two kids back to back in the middle, pods around them. A pod lights up in one of their colors — they run, touch, and come back to the middle. Sometimes two light up at once. When time's up — score, and a new pair right away. Everyone vs. everyone, and a champion of the night at the end. 📱 The host's phone is the coach's remote — it's not a pod. 4 pods in a ~3×3 m square. The two athletes back to back in the middle. The remote draws the pairs.
games.sp_star.name: Agility Star
games.sp_star.tagline: Sprint to a pod, back to base. How many stars in 30 seconds?
games.sp_star.howTo: 5 pods in a circle and a home pod in the middle. Your turn: stand on home, a pod lights up — sprint, touch, back to home and touch home. Only then does the next one light up. How many stars did you get in time? Your personal best is saved for next time. 📱 The host's phone is the coach's remote — it's not a pod. Pod 1 = home in the middle. The other pods in a circle 3–5 m around it. One athlete per turn.
games.sp_beep.name: Beep Test
games.sp_beep.tagline: Run to a pod and back. Every minute the time gets shorter.
games.sp_beep.howTo: Pods in a straight line at different distances. Your pod lights up — run to it, touch, and back to the line. Every 4 shuttles you go up a level and the time gets shorter. Two misses — you're out. What level can you reach? 📱 The host's phone is the coach's remote — it's not a pod. 3–4 pods in a straight line at 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 m from the start line (pod 1 = the closest). Everyone on the line.
games.sp_steal.name: Steal the Round
games.sp_steal.tagline: A pod lights up — the first to touch it switches it off for everyone.
games.sp_steal.howTo: Everyone in the middle, one hand on a cone. A pod lights up white with a stripe in everyone's color — run, and the first to touch their stripe steals the round. The rest get nothing. Back to the middle. First to 10 steals. 📱 The host's phone is the coach's remote — it's not a pod. 6 pods in a circle 4–5 m out. Up to 4 athletes in the middle with a hand on a cone/chair. More than 4 — in rounds.
games.sp_survive.name: Survival
games.sp_survive.tagline: Your color lights up — you've got a few seconds. Or you're out.
games.sp_survive.howTo: Pods scattered around the yard. When your color lights up on any pod — run and touch it before time runs out, or you're out. The time gets shorter with every light. Last one standing wins. 📱 The host's phone is the coach's remote — it's not a pod. 6–8 pods scattered freely, 3–6 m apart. Everyone ready in the middle.
games.sp_relay.name: Relay Race
games.sp_relay.tagline: Two teams. Your touch lights up the next runner.
games.sp_relay.howTo: Two teams, each with a start pod and a far pod. The far pod lights up — the runner runs, touches, comes back and touches the start pod — which lights up the pod for the next runner. No early starts. The team that finishes all its runners first wins. 📱 The host's phone is the coach's remote — it's not a pod. Pods 1+2 = team 🔵 (start, far). Pods 3+4 = team 🔴. 10–15 m between start and far.
games.sp_stations.name: Fire Stations
games.sp_stations.tagline: Your pod lights up and calls an exercise. Do it, touch, next.
games.sp_stations.howTo: The pods are stations around the yard. Your pod lights up and shows an exercise — 10 jumps, plank, squat. Do it, touch — and your next pod lights up somewhere else. How many stations can you get through? 📱 The host's phone is the coach's remote — it's not a pod. 6–8 pods scattered around the yard/hall (on chairs or on the floor). Each athlete starts next to a pod.
games.sp_statue.name: The Statue
games.sp_statue.tagline: The color you touched sets the pose you hold until the next light.
games.sp_statue.howTo: Pods in a circle. Your pod lights up and shows a pose — run, touch, and come back to the middle to hold the pose: plank, squat, one leg… until the next pod lights up — and nobody knows when. Strength and agility in one game. 📱 The host's phone is the coach's remote — it's not a pod. 4–6 pods in a circle ~3 m out. Athletes in the middle. The coach calls a broken pose (−1).
games.sp_pacer.name: Just in Time
games.sp_pacer.tagline: The pod fades. Touch it exactly as it goes out — not early, not late.
games.sp_pacer.howTo: Your pod lights up and slowly fades. The goal: get there and touch it at the exact moment it goes out. Early = hasty, late = asleep. The smallest gap wins — it's about pacing, not speed. Even the little ones can win. 📱 The host's phone is the coach's remote — it's not a pod. 3–4 pods at different distances (5 / 8 / 12 m). Everyone on the start line.
